ordinaryBaseline.coverage: 13 PID/startTicks-bound samples; three 2000 ms idle windows; 24 exact 128-row HTTP responses at concurrency 8; zero forced profiler/GC/queryObjects operations; host cleanup verified.

ordinaryBaseline.sampleDefinitions: PSS is smaps_rollup kernel kB converted to bytes. Heap, external and ArrayBuffer are Node/V8 counters; they do not form a disjoint additive partition of PSS.

sourceDispositions.mechanism: Cold entries stayed strongly reachable below LRU capacity after hard expiry. Ordinary reads now scan a bounded number of entries and delete hard-expired roots.
sourceDispositions.matchedResult: Equivalent 1042-entry fixture: 438 hard-expired reachable entries become zero; 604 useful entries remain. Heap difference after diagnostic collection is 163653752 bytes. PSS did not decrease.
sourceDispositions.guard: packages/operator-core/lib/cache-retention.performance.integration.test.ts; saved runs 20440084 and 20440113. The recurring control removes pruning without requiring historical Git objects.
sourceDispositions.falsifier: Equivalent fixture retains any of the 438 expired roots after the bounded read sweep, loses one of the 604 useful entries, or changes returned values/invalidation/single-flight behavior.
sourceDispositions.limits: Synthetic bodies and diagnostic GC establish root/heap reclamation, not production retained-byte totals, physical savings or production p95.

sourceDispositions.matchedResult: Saved inline/fork fixture: native compiler idle PSS 140925 KiB versus fork caller 4791 KiB after owned worker exit. R24 independently observes the exercised HTTP caller and executable-identified compiler descendants, followed by cleanup.
sourceDispositions.guard: Compiler and mutation-allowlist project suites; cleanup regression WI-10005185 has saved 77 passing tests with zero skips.
sourceDispositions.falsifier: The exercised closure call returns before its owned worker/process group exits, retains executable-identified descendants, or kills an unrelated concurrent compiler.
sourceDispositions.limits: Disposable-worker proof does not identify the original long-lived 4.2 GiB services or establish production memory recovery.

sourceDispositions.observation: Historical four-service census totals about 4.2 GiB PSS. Three rechecked ancestors were live HTTP workers; the fourth exited before ancestry recheck. Orphan/leak findings are not established.
sourceDispositions.nextDistinguishingObservation: Bind a future high-PSS native descendant to executable hash, PID/startTicks, live ancestry, actual invoking compiler path and equivalent completed-work/idle resource windows. Absence in a later census cannot establish recovery of the historical instance.
sourceDispositions.falsifier: A supported non-defect lifetime disposition would be overturned by repeated post-completion retention in the same verified owner and workload. No such disposition is claimed here.

sourceDispositions.observation: Saved sampled allocation stacks locate the decoder; they do not identify the initiating query, unique retained bytes or owning root. Async stacks and bounded query-result diagnostic rings cannot reconstruct a missing historical initiating call.
sourceDispositions.relatedWork: WI-10004929/P-013 is done: matched query-latency and invalidation-rate evidence, with response parity. Its recorded completion supplies no matched PSS/retainer attribution.
sourceDispositions.nextDistinguishingObservation: Identify a current decoded-result owner, capture matched named-query workload and PSS/allocation windows, and compare owner reachability across equivalent completion/idle phases without mutating production profiling.
sourceDispositions.falsifier: A bounded-query non-defect disposition would be overturned by reachable completed results accumulating under equivalent calls while useful-context cardinality stays constant. No universal non-defect disposition is claimed here.

sourceDispositions.observation: Anonymous mappings are not synonymous with native allocations. Cgroup memory includes file cache, kernel memory and descendants. Heap/external/ArrayBuffer counters overlap and cannot be subtracted from PSS to obtain a native total.
sourceDispositions.nextDistinguishingObservation: Use allocation-owner evidence and a matched intervention, with unchanged useful workload and PID/startTicks identity, before attributing an anonymous/PSS remainder.
sourceDispositions.falsifier: An allocator-fragmentation claim is rejected unless owner-specific allocation/free behavior distinguishes it from live data or code and shows the claimed PSS effect.
